### Regions Financial Corp. to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on October 16


Sep 16, 2026


*Results to be issued pre-market open; executives to review results via webcast at 10 a.m. ET.*


BIRMINGHAM, Ala.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Regions Financial Corp.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com%2F&esheet=54604500&newsitemid=20260916156019&lan=en-US&anchor=Regions+Financial+Corp.&index=1&md5=f0fc9b20cfc7fed505192b15721ed4ca) (NYSE:RF) is scheduled to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Friday, Oct. 16, 2026.


Information will be accessible in the following formats:


- A news release and additional materials will be made available on Regions’ Investor Relations website at[ir.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.regions.com%2F&esheet=54604500&newsitemid=20260916156019&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.regions.com&index=2&md5=852259865f62a6b0b044507ec977f2a4) prior to market open on Oct. 16.
- Also on Oct. 16, Regions executives will discuss the results via an audio webcast beginning at 10 a.m. ET.
- The webcast will be accessible in real-time through[ir.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.regions.com%2F&esheet=54604500&newsitemid=20260916156019&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.regions.com&index=3&md5=df739a4f9c04450da6461ada05de80f4) and will include an associated slide presentation to be reviewed by company executives.
- An archived recording of the webcast will be made available within[ir.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.regions.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents-and-presentations&esheet=54604500&newsitemid=20260916156019&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.regions.com&index=4&md5=d4f3c55c89a4a2c6f7716aaf6d840047) following the live Q&A with analysts.


**About Regions Financial Corporation**


Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $161 billion in assets, is a member of the S&P 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services. Regions serves customers across the South, Midwest and Texas, and through its subsidiary, Regions Bank, operates more than 1,200 banking offices and more than 1,750 ATMs. Regions Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and Member FDIC. Additional information about Regions and its full line of products and services can be found at[www.regions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.regions.com&esheet=54604500&newsitemid=20260916156019&lan=en-US&anchor=www.regions.com&index=5&md5=f080cfc614872e8a79bef644567e64e7) .
